a.text: Great Kjeragandr, we walk beside Her.
The clouds Her feathers, the wind Her wings.
She bestows upon us sunlight and sweet rains, flesh and furs.
Benevolent Kjeragandr, we hold love for Her.
The mountains Her bones, the rivers Her tail.
We walk upon Her back, we sleep soundly in Her arms.
Merciful Kjeragandr, we sing praises to Her.
When we are afeared, it is She who soothes us.
When we are imperiled, it is She who saves us.
Kjeragandr blesses Her faithful, blesses Her mounts and beasts, that we may live in peace apart from calamity, in eternal serenity.

steps.text: 1100, Kjerag, Paleroche territory, at the foot of Mount Karlan.

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Faster!

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Don't forget what we're here to do! In the back, keep pace!

steps.name: Stern Soldier
steps.text: Aye!

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Halt! Gather up!

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Form up!

steps.name: Stern Soldier
steps.text: Sir! Reporting in! Second Squad in formation, sir!

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Very good then.

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Has Third Squad reported in?

steps.name: Stern Soldier
steps.text: Sir! Not yet, sir!

steps.name: Stern Soldier
steps.text: Sir, it's possible that Third Squad has run into trouble...

steps.name: Stern Soldier
steps.text: Should we wait for them to catch up to us?

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: No. I had a feeling something like this might happen. Whoever's here first has to be the first to strike!

steps.name: Stern Soldier
steps.text: Aye!

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: I don't think I need to go over the plan again.

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: This is an expedition, a right proper Victorian battle! A battle for glory!

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Stay alert! Do not underestimate the enemy! We will prevail! Failure is not an option!

steps.name: Stern Soldier
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Good, keep those spirits up!

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Second Squad, march on!

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: Our objective—the stockherd's inn at the foot of the mountain!

steps.name: Lead Soldier
steps.text: We must not let these provincials drink us under the table! This time it will be them who taste defeat!

steps.name: Stern Soldier
steps.text: YES, SIR!

steps.name: Common Kjerag Man
steps.text: What are those Victorians up to this time?

steps.name: Common Kjerag Woman
steps.text: Testing their alcohol tolerance, I think? It's been a whole lot of times with Riley's boys. I hear they're always drinking till they vomit.

steps.name: Common Kjerag Woman
steps.text: By Kjeragandr...

steps.name: Common Kjerag Woman
steps.text: Victorians... If they've got all this free time, then what are they even doing?

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: No, this one's no good.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: 'Dremomys' ... Hmm, doesn't sound half bad...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What do you think, Yucatan? How do you like 'Dremomys'?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Sounds good.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ugh, don't you have anything else to say?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Every name I suggest, you just say it sounds good!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: ...Really?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: But I really do think that all the names you suggest sound good, Rus.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Nope, can't trust you. I'll need to go over them again. I mean, we're talking about our first...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What I'm trying to say is that I'm definitely going to pick the best name!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: 'Dremomys' is the one to beat for now. 'Tamiops' sounds pretty good too.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Oh, right! We can also pick a nickname! Something like... 'Nut'!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Pipe down already. I could hear you shouting from outside.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And what's this about a 'Nut'? Picking out names for your kid?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Good day, Matriarch.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: No, definitely not...!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: M-Mind your own stupid business!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Alright, no more teasing.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Kjeragandr's statue is done. We'll have a ceremony for it in a couple of days.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And I'm afraid I'll be very busy with everything involved in that. You two are going to have to handle anything that might pop up in our territory.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I can handle it! Just relax!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If my darling little sister is handling it, there's no way I can relax.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I'm not gonna mess anything up this time. You won't get to yell at me.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Yucatan, do make sure your wife doesn't wear that gormless look on her face out in public.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Laugh it up! I'm telling you, Ratatos, I've got my own plans this time!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: And when they come to fruition, that Enciodes is going to owe us Browntails a favor, just you wait and see!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Well, I guess I'll just have to wait and see.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I'll put my faith in you for now, but here's a word to the wise: try and keep a level head.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Kjeragandr's statue, the Victorians, not to mention Enciodes's scheming...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: *sigh* A lot of big things to worry about.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I'm afraid... we're not exactly in for a peaceful time here.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Outrageous! The Victorians have gone too far!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You need only say the word, my Saintess, and I'll gather my men and chase the louts out of Kjerag!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Please calm down, Sir Arctosz.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The Victorian soldiers are only here to congratulate us on the completion of Kjeragandr's statue.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What kind of congratulating needs two thousand men? It's a pretense!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: They set up camp at the foot of Mount Karlan, those faithless bastards! Surely it would anger Kjeragandr to allow blasphemers at the ceremony!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: My Saintess! Are we really going to let them do as they please on our land?!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You are not wrong. I am well aware that they hold no reverence for Kjeragandr in their hearts.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Then we should—!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: That is precisely why we should not.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Do you believe that our statue of Kjeragandr was built only for the faithful to revere?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I, well...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Look. Look upon the statue.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Three years ago, we accepted the proposal of the Silverash clan, and it was decided that atop Lake Silberneherze we would build a statue of Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: She would be solemn and stately. She would be merciful and magnanimous.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: She has become that which lifts the spirits of the people of Kjerag. She has become a symbol of Kjerag to the outside world.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: As anyone should have predicted, there will be more visitors to Kjerag in the future, and with them will come many unavoidable challenges.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You say that, but—

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: There is no 'but', Sir Arctosz.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The people of Kjerag's faith in Kjeragandr is unshakable. That is incomprehensible to outsiders.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Faithful or faithless, one who comes before this statue will find oneself bathed in Her light.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: But, Great Saintess, that isn't what's happening here!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: If they were just ordinary tourists, I wouldn't be sounding the alarm! But those men are the Victorian Army! It's not the same!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Are they an 'army', or are they a 'noble's guard'?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Or might they be 'Victoria' herself?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: They've come to Kjerag on a mission of congratulations. We have no reason to refuse or rebuff them.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: They're clearly up to no good here, so just in case...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: As it stands, I still do not endorse some of Sir Enciodes's overly risky decisions.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Despite all the growth that they have brought to Kjerag...

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What has Enciodes been up to these past three years?

spans.text: Enciodes been up to these past three years?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: He's been making smaller moves on the mineral export issue. Could this Victorian business be another one of his disastrous schemes?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...I cannot say.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You cannot say?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I bcannot say, Sir Arctosz.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Whatever Sir Enciodes is plotting behind our backs, it will all be in the manner that he sees most fit. I and the Vine-Bead Court alike would not be familiar with his line of thought.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Sometimes, knowing too much is not a good thing.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You mean to say...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I'm just stating the facts, nothing more.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: The ceremony must go off without a hitch. For now, we'll make our preparations. Whatever we can do, as best as we can.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: You need not be so worried.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Whatever may come...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjeragandr will protect Her people.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: What is on your mind, Saintess?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I was pondering what Arctosz said, about Kjeragandr's statue...

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I hope the ceremony goes smoothly.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: It will.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: 'Kjeragandr will protect Her people', no?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I still hope we won't need to bother Her this time.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You wish for Her to simply watch?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Kjerag must learn to face risks and challenges.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: A child can't spend its whole life in its mother's arms, Kjarr.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: ...That much is true.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Ah, yet another chat has turned rather morose.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Speaking of the statue of Kjeragandr, I've half a mind to give that Arctosz a slap.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: He got that big statue's face out of some ancient records, correct? The one it's got right now.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Did he really have to say 'Kjeragandr's appearance is preserved in these books! You are not to deviate from them!'? Who says my...?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: *cough* Who says Kjeragandr's face is so wide?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Definitely deserves a slap or two!

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Saintess?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Enya?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Why'd you turn so quiet?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: No, you're just teasing me again. Surely.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Could I...? No, could Kjeragandr... actually have such a wide face?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: In two days, the Saintess will perform the early morning blessing, in celebration of the completion of Kjeragandr's statue.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Here is your invitation, My Lord.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: Ah, Sir Enciodes, haha, that is how Kjerag's folk address you, yes?

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: You are far too kind. We had come specifically for this purpose, and I would not have dared to trouble you for a special invitation.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: Worry not, my boys and I will arrive on time, all to celebrate the completion of our statue of Kjeragandr... O Blessed Kjeragandr!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...You seem to have adapted well to life in Kjerag.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: Kjerag's scenery is a beauty, her dishes unique, and her people most lively. What's not to like?

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: Not for nothing does Her Grace so often praise Kjerag's natural bounties. I dare say it's lived up to its reputation!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...Her Grace flatters us.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: To have esteemed guests from afar praise us in such a way is an honor for Kjerag and the Silverash clan both.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: No need to be modest, Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: Though we came here to congratulate you on the completion of the statue, I can say that I've been thoroughly captivated by Kjerag's charms during my stay.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: I hope that Her Grace, magnanimous as she is, will allow me to extend my pleasurable stay in Kjerag after the ceremony.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: Sir Enciodes, surely you'll permit me to do some sightseeing, yes?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...But of course.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Considering that My Lord is eager to gain a deeper understanding of Kjerag, I see no reason to refuse.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Though I would note that in this season, Kjerag's winds are bitterly cold, and many unseen dangers lurk atop the mountains.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You and your guards will need to bundle up warmly. I would also request that you steer clear of certain dangerous areas during your tour, so as to avoid blizzards and frostbite.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: Truly a most considerate warning!

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: Kjerag really is a bit too chilly, but don't you worry, Sir Enciodes. That's hardly a problem for us. A thick coat should do the trick.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: Of course, speaking personally, I prefer to relax in a warm cabin with a roaring fireplace to traipsing about a snowy wonderland atop some mountain. With some fondue afterwards.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: Oh, that flavor, mmm!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I am relieved to hear you say that, My Lord.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: Relieved? Oh, heavens no, I wouldn't go that far.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: I'm afraid you can't feel too relieved, Sir Enciodes. You should keep your wits about you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Please, elaborate.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: Oh, your relationship with Her Grace notwithstanding, I'm afraid there are many things that I'm not at ease to speak about.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: Our friend so kind to those of lower station, with such affection for Kjerag... but is this affection returned by the worthy? Patience certainly has its limits.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: And if our cooperation within Kjerag continues along a rough path, well, should Her Grace decide her patience has reached an end...

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: I'm sure we would both rather not let things come to that, Sir Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I understand your meaning, My Lord.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As for that 'cooperation', I will give you my response within the next few days. I will not keep Her Grace waiting too long.

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: I'm looking forward to hearing some good news from you, then.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You'll be the first to know.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Having handed over the invitation, I have no further need to trouble you, My Lord.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I look forward to seeing you at the ceremony in two days.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: That Kjerag fellow didn't even offer a 'hello' as he passed. What a stuck-up prick!

steps.name: Victorian Viscount
steps.text: It's just a show he's put on for me.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: A show? You men of learning, spending your days playing your games...

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Harold, I can tell you've been in a bad mood these past few days. Is he giving you trouble?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Perish the thought! Sure, the lad's got some skills, but nothing to lose sleep over.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Alright, enough of that. No use trying to hide from what's coming, so let's go do what must be done!

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Good to hear that you know what you're doing.

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: If that's all, then I best hurry off first. *hic* I'm counting on you to handle those fancy nobs, Harold!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Wait, just a moment there, did you lot go drinking without me again?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Just one moment! Set the drink aside, did you finish the fondue I was only halfway done with?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Zzz... *snore*...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: (Kjerag) Grüezi... Ha det...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Zzz... Zzz...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Mamochka...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Don't worry... Zzz... I can do it...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: *unintelligible Kjerag*

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: *snore*... Zzz...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Who's there?! Who has the guts to ambush me—!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: How long have I been asleep...?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Ugh... My butt hurts. This ride's real bumpy, feels like my whole body is shaking apart.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Mmm—hah. That's much comfier.
The girl sits upright, picking up the book she was using the pass the time, which had rolled under the chair at some point, and stuffing it into her bag.
She does a big stretch, spotting something out the carriage window.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: So this is Kjerag...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: It's just snow.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: And mountains.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: It's got a few more of those than Ursus, but other than that, what's the difference? Snow everywhere, dry and cold.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I don't see what's worth you always going on about...
Attention passengers, the train is arriving at the terminal—the base of Mount Karlan, Kjerag.
All passengers, please prepare your luggage and alight in an orderly fashion.
For those passengers continuing on to the city, transfer at Platform 2, or take the bus.
For those passengers continuing on to Lake Silberneherze, or to see the newly completed statue of Kjeragandr, please transfer at Platform 3.
Welcome to Kjerag! We wish you a pleasant journey!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Whew! Here at last!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: 'Scuse me, pardon me, sorry about that!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Whew, finally made it out...!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Wow, crazy, the station is way too crowded!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright, let me see, get off the train and turn left, leave through the ticketing gates, and then...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: ...Hey, what's the deal with this map?!

steps.name: Feisty Burdenbeast
steps.text: Moo—!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Whoa! Wha-What the hell!

steps.name: Feisty Burdenbeast
steps.text: Moo—! Moo—!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh? A burdenbeast? Why's there a burdenbeast in the station...?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You look like a real tough one.

steps.name: Burdenbeast Herder
steps.text: Hoho, young lady, could this be your first time in Kjerag?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Not bad, muzhchina. How'd you figure that one out?

steps.name: Burdenbeast Herder
steps.text: Hah, I have an eye for foreigners, I pick 'em out with just a glance.

steps.name: Burdenbeast Herder
steps.text: You could say that this burdenbeast's our own Kjerag specialty, one named by the Great Saintess herself!

steps.name: Burdenbeast Herder
steps.text: They're called, uh, what was it again... Oh right! They're called 'BangBang Burdenbeast'!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: 'BangBang Burdenbeast'...?

steps.name: Feisty Burdenbeast
steps.text: Moo, moomoo—

steps.name: Burdenbeast Herder
steps.text: That's right, that's what they're called!

steps.name: Burdenbeast Herder
steps.text: Look here, young lady. Over here.

steps.name: Burdenbeast Herder
steps.text: If you want to take the burdenbeast for a ride, just press this button here, and the pen opens.

steps.name: Feisty Burdenbeast
steps.text: Moo!

steps.name: Burdenbeast Herder
steps.text: Alright, settle down, settle down.

steps.name: Burdenbeast Herder
steps.text: We've been taming these beasts for a long while now. Each and every one of them handpicked, and they're smart to boot!

steps.name: Burdenbeast Herder
steps.text: Wherever you're heading, just put the fare in that pouch on the burdenbeast when you get there, and you're solid!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Haha! Sounds fun! Can I really ride this burdenbeast down the street? That's super cool! I'm in!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hey, muzhchina, what happens if someone just... doesn't pay?

steps.name: Burdenbeast Herder
steps.text: I think you'll find, young lady, it's not quite so easy to cut and run in Kjerag!

steps.name: Burdenbeast Herder
steps.text: Didn't you see the disclaimer over there?

steps.name: Feisty Burdenbeast
steps.text: Moo—! Moomoomoo!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Let's take a look...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: 'In the case of any breach of contract by the customer, the company holds no responsibility for attacks by the supplied burdenbeast, or any other bodily injury or loss/damage of property'...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Will the burdenbeast take the cash itself or something?

steps.name: Feisty Burdenbeast
steps.text: Moomoo!

steps.name: Feisty Burdenbeast
steps.text: Hrrmh—! Hrrmph—moo!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Well alright then! That's exactly how you should handle faredodgers!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'll definitely give it a try if I get a chance later!

steps.name: Burdenbeast Herder
steps.text: That's great to hear, young lady.

steps.name: Burdenbeast Herder
steps.text: Well, I won't keep you any longer. Welcome to Kjerag!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, wait a sec, muzhchina...!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: He sure walks fast. I was going to ask him which way I should go...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: If I cross over there... Hmm, that should be right, right?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Platform 3, Platform 3...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Halt! Gather up!

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Form up!

steps.name: Stern Soldier
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Curious Woman
steps.text: Why are there soldiers in the train station?

steps.name: Curious Woman
steps.text: Did something happen?

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: Attention!

steps.name: Stern Soldier
steps.text: Aye!

steps.name: Bold Man
steps.text: No need to worry, last time I saw them buy some knickknacks to take home. Maybe they just came for some sightseeing.

steps.name: Bold Man
steps.text: Though it looks like their uniforms aren't very warm. You see? That young fellow over there's so cold his nose is running!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: (Dammit, wipe your nose already!)

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: (Where are those coats I bought you? Why aren't you wearing them?)

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: (Harold, please! Those coats you bought... they've all got 'I ♥ Snow' stitched on!)

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: (What's the problem? I think they look great.)

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: (I think they look great too.)

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: (Alright, you keep wearing yours then.)

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: (Hey, wait, who's the kid?!)

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Me? Oh, don't mind me, you guys keep talking.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I was just curious as to why there was a big crowd blocking the way, so I had a look-see... When I heard you all talking I couldn't help but join in.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: No need to apologize! You are a lady of excellent taste!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Excellent taste... You mean me? Haha, you sure can call them like you see them!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I was just looking at those coats myself! The 'I ♥ Snow' is a little kitschy, but they really are super warm!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: *cough*!

steps.name: Seasoned Soldier
steps.text: I gotta say, Harold, you're right. The lady really does have excellent taste.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Say, dedushka, you're not just ordinary tourists, are you? What are you guys doing in Kjerag?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Dedushka? Ursine for grandfather, I believe? Fair enough, I suppose you're about the same age as my no-good daughter back home.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: As for what we're here to do, haha, we're just here for sightseeing, same as you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm not just here for sightseeing though.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, right, do you know how to get to Platform 3?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Platform 3?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Yeah, I'm supposed to transfer there to get to Lake Silberneherze.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I'm guessing you don't know either then? Damn, I better go ask someone else then—

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Hold!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: If it's Platform 3 you're after... then you've come to the right man!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: If you were to ask who knows best the nooks and crannies of this terminal, I, Harold Craigavon, would be your answer!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Oh, wow! Are you for real?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Entirely. I would never lie to a lady.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Since I took my first step off the train one month ago, I have found myself a captive of this bustling terminal!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I've whiled away the hours perusing every shop, to the point that I was invited to cut the ribbon for the opening of that souvenir shop there!

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: I dare say that the burdenbeasts here treat my fellows and I a touch bit kinder than your average tourist!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh... You sure about that?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I mean, look, the burdenbeast you're talking about is nibbling on that guy's clothes.

steps.name: Rude Burdenbeast
steps.text: Mmm! Moo!

steps.name: Rude Burdenbeast
steps.text: (*chews*)

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: It's as you say, this little fellow is a pea in our pod.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hahahaha! I don't think your man was expecting to be stuck in that particular pod!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hah... Whew, you're too much.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Alright, that's enough of that. I need to hit the road. Hope I can get to Lake Silberneherze before it's dark...

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Hold it. Listen.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Did you hear that, young lady?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Hear what...? That platform announcement?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Correct. It happens to be announcing the arrival of the train at Platform 3.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: And it seems that I, coincidentally, am headed the same way as you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: You are?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: To put it more plainly, my destination is the statue of Kjeragandr atop Lake Silberneherze.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Not just my destination, mind you. All these upstanding young fellows as well. We're all getting on that train.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: In two days' time, everyone will be gazing upon that grand statue... And that's precisely why we're here.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: This Kjeragandr statue they built, is it really that amazing...?

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Perhaps so! As a tourist myself, I do think it will become quite the popular attraction.

steps.name: Harold
steps.text: Now, with that all said—I'm hoping I could have the pleasure of your company on our little tour, young lady?
